resources.string: Everyone listens differently. Choose the settings that feel comfortable for you.
Read along in a familiar language when a translation is available.
Follow along with romanization when the lyrics include it.
Bring both channels together for listening with one earbud.
Choose the balance that feels comfortable. Other sound adjustments stay as you set them.
Both outputs carry the same sound in mono mode. Switch back to stereo to adjust left and right balance.
Strict direct output bypasses channel adjustments and volume normalization. Switch output mode to use these controls.
Use existing loudness information in songs to reduce volume changes between tracks.
Pause when headphones disconnect to avoid unexpected speaker playback.
Keep this off if you prefer to start playback yourself after reconnecting.
Let the music pause while you rest. You can cancel the timer at any time.
Playback will pause at the end of the current track.
